description: Read this workspace's Merchant Center link. status is linked, pending, expired, error, or none (nothing started). accounts lists Merchant Center account ids and the connection each one belongs to. connections lists stored rows, including revoked, and which feeds are attached. When status is pending and accounts has more than one entry, the owner has not chosen yet: call select_merchant_account with connectionId, accountId and feedId. Does not return tokens or the consent URL.
name: get_merchant_link
title: Get Merchant Center link
